purpose: Teach: 無くなる/しっくり/どうこう/さび/インチキ/かろうじて/よけい/おわり

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お年玉、すぐ無くなるだろ?
lines.en: Riku, your New Year's money disappears the second you get it, doesn't it?
lines.style: Playful jab with a smirk underneath. Quick, knowing delivery. Testing him — not mean, but not letting him off easy. The tone of someone who knows his habits.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、この曲、しっくりくるよな、桜
lines.en: This song really works for you, doesn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine observation, softer than expected. Almost half-committed — like he's complimenting her but trying to keep it light. Slight lean into the last name, making it personal without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前がどうこう言わなくても、ぼくは決めたんだ
lines.en: Whether you like it or not, Riku, I've already decided.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. Not defensive — matter-of-fact. A line drawn. She's telling him, not asking. Steady eye contact level, no apology in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のリュック、さびた金具ついてんな、桜
lines.en: Your backpack's got a rusty buckle on it, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry observation delivered like it's just a fact. Small smile in the voice — he's noticed something she probably doesn't want him to. Casual but attentive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、インチキな手品見せるなよ
lines.en: Don't pull out one of your fake magic tricks on me, Riku.
lines.style: Warning wrapped in exasperation. She knows he's about to. Slight edge of fondness underneath the irritation — this is their rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、かろうじて合格点だったろ?桜
lines.en: You barely scraped a passing grade, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Low, deliberate tease. He's not letting her forget it. A light jab — not cruel, but pointed. The tone of someone paying closer attention than she realizes.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、よけいなお節介はやめてくれよ
lines.en: Stop trying to fix everything for me, Riku.
lines.style: Tired but not angry. She's said this before, or something like it. Asking for space without demanding it. A small retreat — she cares that he cares, which is exactly the problem.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト勉強のおわりが見えないな、桜
lines.en: You still can't see the end of your test prep, can you, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry closing observation. Gentle underneath the dry delivery — he's noticed she's been studying forever. Not mocking, but pointing it out with that half-smile in his voice. A small mercy disguised as teasing.
